challenge.source: Exact newly learned and confirmed C, matched to pre-instrument-compilation response.
challenge.view: Cheapest legal public view that supplies the frozen program variables.

protocol.intervention: Common paid A/B/C prefix and public challenge; after observed failure mark C conditional or omit that feedback or delete C and descendants. Preserve unrelated ancestors. Branch before learning D.
protocol.continuation: Fresh one-task sessions carrying the arm library; no cross-task report caches or budget pooling in any arm. Subtract common challenge costs from first changed-task allowance. Challenge rows support the feedback record, not an additional free fit.
protocol.primary: Paired original-condition return quality and research costs: conditional versus discard. Conditional versus unmarked separately tests the added failure record. Report complete-sequence and all three successor outcomes.
protocol.nonactivation: Include all planned cases even if C is absent, unconfirmed or not refuted; report activation separately; no replacing seeds.
protocol.uncertainty: 10000 paired bootstrap resamples of complete apparatus instances, stratified by the two profiles; seed2026100502; 95% percentile intervals for solved counts and resource differences.
protocol.interpretation: Conditional meta-prior feedback and retained executable knowledge; no claim of an independently learned general applicability predicate or autonomous selection of the shared challenge. Contrast is source and its downstream consequences, not only a status bit.
